description: Defines a class for an angular pointing marker in a graph rendering library, extending a base pointing marker class, with methods for drawing the marker with specific angular properties.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Pointing_Angular
classes.description: A marker class that points away from the graph with a specified angular length, extending the base pointing marker class.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Pointing_Angular
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the angular marker with a radius and an end marker.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the angular marker on the canvas, calculating deltas based on data values and calling the parent draw method.
